Every member below is in work/reference-pools/pool-36.json with gate <= 36 and a source_detail map the player has already passed on the way to Route 113/114: Seaspray Cave B1F (Sneasel), Rusturf Tunnel (Drilbur), Petalburg City Old Rod (Magikarp), Route 102 (Togepi), Mauville Game Corner (Litten), Granite Cave 1F (Abra). No Route 118+, Mt. Pyre, desert-interior or post-Flannery sources are used. Mega Ring earned from Steven after Brawly (C13); Gyaradosite stone window 20. Route 114 is reached from Fallarbor per Game Book C20/C21. Adds NewMauville_Entrance (Magnezone gate 30) and the Alakazite stone window 20 from the pool; the Mega Ring is earned from Steven after Brawly (C13).
plan: Kai is Octolock trapping plus a Yawn/Brine pressure lane behind two bulky Fighting-adjacent walls. Two of the four members are part Fighting (Grapploct, Chesnaught) and both are 2x into Psychic, so Mega Alakazam is the ace and Togekiss's Air Slash is 4x into Grass/Fighting Chesnaught. Magnezone's Thunderbolt is 2x into both Water types (Sealeo, Greninja) and Excadrill's Iron Head is 2x into Sealeo's Ice half, so every member of Kai's team has a dedicated answer. Two things to respect: Octolock will show up in switch_blocked_by and I must not plan on escaping it, and Chesnaught's Bulletproof blanks ball and bomb moves - Alakazam's usual Focus Blast and Shadow Ball are both blocked, which is why this build carries Dazzling Gleam instead of Focus Blast.
